head.title: Reckon House · Design & Build
head.description: The portfolio of Jeremy Prasatik, an independent designer and developer in Texas. Apps, ecommerce, campaigns, brand systems, interiors, and AI tools, with case studies for each.
head.ogImageAlt: Reckon House. Work by Jeremy Prasatik: the Robert Rodriguez campaign, the Ivy Park launch, and the A.R.C. app.

index.intro: Reckon House. Jeremy Prasatik makes things across brand, product, and place: apps and ecommerce, campaigns and brand systems, photography and art direction, custom interiors, AI tools. Every study, in its own words, at the links below; ask the site anything about them.

statement.lead: This is an index of design across brand, product and place. Each project records the problem, the decisions and what was made, and is cross-referenced by discipline, capability, figure and tool.

lines: Sites, stores and platforms, designed and shipped.
Native tools and AI products, built end to end.
Design systems, internal tools and new ways of working.
Creative direction and execution for international brands.
Marks, type and patterns, on packaging, print and apparel.
Rooms designed like products, down to the hardware.
Pictures and lines saved from other people's work.

news: A.R.C. launched on the App Store
Point the camera at a room and it names what is there, estimates replacement value, and shows the gap against your policy as a dollar amount. Solo, end to end: concept, code, brand, go-to-market.
A.R.C. is on the App Store.
Sally OS is rolling out to the enterprise

Sally OS is rolling out to the enterprise.

sections.name: About
sections.lede: I can work across an organization, or take something new with no structure and make something of it.
body: I spent eight years at Nordstrom, where I worked with engineering to roll out a new CMS and led the redesign of the digital experience, from marketing down to the product page.
I've taken a new app from idea through brand and code, and made the marketing platform that a 2,000-store retailer now runs on daily.
I'm a tinkerer. My degree is in management information systems, and my first job was at a six-person startup, where I ran all the digital and print marketing and wrote the front end for a custom CMS.

sections.name: Design
sections.lede: I've been doing experience design and creative direction for twenty years, across digital products, stores and homes.
body: I've worked for Neiman Marcus, JCPenney, Nordstrom, At Home, PetSmart and Sally Beauty. At Nordstrom I directed a team of 27 across site, email and apps, and led the US digital launch of Ivy Park by Beyoncé, six weeks from concept to live.
At Sally Beauty I lead design teams and outside agencies across digital and 2,000+ stores, including a full redesign of the digital experience and a new boutique store concept.
Somewhere in there I spent a couple of years deep in custom homes, leading interior design and selections on $1-3M builds. Floor & Decor named me Designer of the Quarter in 2023.

sections.name: Process & Workflow
sections.lede: I know how things get made inside a big company, and I put new ways of working into practice.
body: At Nordstrom the new CMS saved $3M over four years. Redesigning the UI and templates cut concept-to-web time 35% and lifted customer engagement 22%.

At Sally Beauty and CosmoProf I built the in-house creative teams and a new operating model that raised execution efficiency 27%. At PetSmart, new site patterns, email templates and AI-assisted product photography lifted creative output 30%.

sections.name: AI & Technology
sections.lede: I build the tools as much as the output.
body: Sally OS is a marketing platform I came up with and built at Sally Beauty. It went in front of the board, leadership approved it, and it's used across the company. A full campaign on Sally OS goes from request to execution in hours instead of weeks.

Sally OS reads competitor research and voice-of-customer data, plans a campaign, then writes and designs the emails, web assets and signage, and delivers them into Figma through a plugin I wrote. It answers from what the brand has shipped, and a governance layer holds automated work to the same standard as anything made by hand.

A.R.C. is an iPhone app for home inventory that I designed and coded end to end. For Dallas Sport Collective I made a scheduling system where athletes and trainers book by talking to an AI, and the scheduling underneath stays deterministic.
Claude Code is this site's CMS, design tool and build environment at once.
